protocol.objective: Reject all 22 reviewed false acceptances while preserving every local tree prediction and all 38 previously correct accepted transfer routes.
protocol.development_boundary: The former transfer set now explicitly participates in rejection calibration. Its post-fit precision is not held-out performance.
protocol.negative_selection: All previously accepted wrong predictions, no subset selection.
protocol.protected_selection: All original local inputs plus every previously accepted correct transfer input.
protocol.runtime: Declared Boolean clauses only; no source/image IDs, instruction text lookup, human labels or changed verdicts at inference.
protocol.fallback: Exact regular judge, unchanged; its saved responses are replayed by input content.

verification.validation_scope: Post-calibration regression verification; the reviewed transfer outcomes are development data.
